rationale: Deviation D-2 (docs/f0-deviations.md): pub cross-module visibility enforcement is a deferred F0 decision, not an accidental gap -- it is a no-op for this library today (flat, all-pub module surface, SS-U08's nested-module rejection already covers the one enforceable structural case). rationale: Deviation D-3 (docs/f0-deviations.md), Decision 3A: a contract clause the backend cannot lower emits a stable model-only note and sv0 verify is the enforcement mechanism -- this is a permanent, sound architectural decision (sv0doc Section 3.1 normative), not a temporary gap awaiting a fix.

Deviation D-5 (docs/f0-deviations.md): sv0 verify already proves full-interval non-overlap for every audited call site (corpus interval_overlap.sv0 upstream, plus the E0323 borrow-conflict probe exercised by c23_memcpy_overlap.sv0 in this repo); only the no_alias length-upgrade (widening the proof to length-mismatched slices) is deferred. Partial, not blocking -- the safety property (no aliasing UB) is already proven for the cases this library constructs.

Deviation D-10 (docs/f0-deviations.md, SS-187): strings_cstr::concat performs two string_concat allocations, not the literal "at most once" PERF-004 asks for, because sv0 has no 3-ary string-construction primitive. The pre-allocation overflow check still runs fully before either call; the count is a bounded constant (2), never proportional to input size. A genuine fix needs a new Track U runtime primitive.
expiration: Track U runtime primitive lands (N-ary concat or dynamic buffer builder), no fixed date
